title: Odisha startup BabyCue wins national challenge with its rapid diagnostic test for children
summary: Odisha-based BabyCue wins first prize at the Tribal Business Conclave Open Grand Challenge for DiaCue, its rapid test for childhood diarrhoea.
llm_summary: Odisha‑based startup BabyCue clinched the top prize at the Tribal Business Conclave’s Open Grand Challenge for its DiaCue rapid diagnostic test, which detects childhood diarrhoea within minutes. The low‑cost, point‑of‑care device aims to speed up treatment and reduce mortality in remote and underserved areas, showcasing how frugal biotech can address critical public‑health gaps.
